A '''prototype''' [[Hovertank|hover tank]] was used by the [[Rike's Raiders]] during their [[Assault on Denova|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denova]]. It was piloted by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Amos Rike]] and eventually destroyed by the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[Alliance Commander|Commander]].<ref name="TRN" />
